args.code:
# The algorithm:
# edx starts at 0xffffffcd (which in a 32-bit context is -51 or 205 as unsigned byte)
# For each position i from 0 to 26:
#   input[i] XOR (edx & 0xFF) should equal target_ct[i]
#   edx = (edx + input[i]) & 0xffffffff (32-bit arithmetic)

target_ct = bytes([
    0x8b, 0x5f, 0x1e, 0xe7, 0x9c, 0x11, 0xa1, 0x28,
    0xde, 0x77, 0xe8, 0x98, 0x17, 0x88, 0x5a, 0xc3,
    0x77, 0x03, 0x82, 0x37, 0xd2, 0x43, 0x43, 0x87,
    0xd4, 0x29, 0x30
])

# Reverse the cipher:
# input[i] = target_ct[i] XOR (edx & 0xFF)
# Then update edx

edx = 0xffffffcd  # Starting value
result = []

for i in range(27):
    char = target_ct[i] ^ (edx & 0xFF)
    result.append(chr(char))
    edx = (edx + char) & 0xffffffff

print("Decoded input:", ''.join(result))
